PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 cargo_var varchar2(100);
 tran_var varchar2(100);
 dt varchar(300);
 grp varchar2(1000);
 ctg varchar2(3000);
 trn varchar2 (2000);
V_TITLE varchar2(2000);
V_TITLE1 varchar2(2000);
V_TITLE2 varchar2(2000);
V_TITLE3 varchar2(2000);
port_val varchar2(2000);
TIM VARCHAR2(300);
P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

BEGIN
 if :end_dt > HijDate.cur_hij_date or :start_dt > HijDate.cur_hij_date then
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 30,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;

 if :start_dt is null or :end_dt is null then
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 90,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;

 if :start_dt > :end_dt then
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 50,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;

END;

 IF :PORT IS NULL THEN 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PORT;
 END IF;

 V_TITLE1 := :parameter.P_MODULE_NAME;
 V_TITLE1 := ' تقرير شاحنات البضائع ';
 IF :P_WITH_CNTNRS = 1 THEN
 V_TITLE2 := ' التي وردت بحاويات ';
 ELSIF :P_WITH_CNTNRS = 2 THEN
 V_TITLE2 := ' التي وردت بدون حاويات ';
 ELSIF :P_WITH_CNTNRS = 3 THEN
 V_TITLE2 := ' التي وردت بحاويات وبدون حاويات ';
 END IF;

 IF :P_TYPE = 1 THEN
 V_TITLE3 := ' (تفصيلي) ';
 ELSIF :P_TYPE = 2 THEN
 V_TITLE3 := ' (احصائي) ';
 END IF;

 V_TITLE := LTRIM(RTRIM(V_TITLE1))||' '||
 LTRIM(RTRIM(V_TITLE2))||' '||
 LTRIM(RTRIM(V_TITLE3));

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
--======================================================
SELECT 1
FROM 
DECLARATIONS,
DCLTN_GATE_TRANS, 
SEA_DLVY_ITEMS, 
VSSL_BL_ITEMS 

WHERE
 (
(DECLARATIONS.GATE_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT) 
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 1)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 9)

 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 3)
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL)
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL)

 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD = DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR = DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT = DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ)

 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ)

) 

 AND ((:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 1 AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ > 0) OR 
 (:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 2 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL OR VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ = 0)) OR 
 (:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 3 ) )
--======================================================
-----------------------------------------
UNION ALL
SELECT 1
FROM 
DCLTN_GATE_TRANS, 
DECLARATIONS,
SEA_DLVY_ORDERS, 
SEA_DLVY_ITEMS, 
VSSL_BL_ITEMS 

WHERE
 (
 (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IN (1,2))
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL)
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL)

 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)

AND (DECLARATIONS.GATE_DT BETWEEN :START_DT AND :END_DT) 

 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 1)
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD = 9)

 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)

 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR)
 AND (SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT = SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT)

 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT)
 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ)
) 
 AND ((:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 1 AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ > 0) OR 
 (:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 2 AND (VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL OR VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ = 0)) OR 
 (:P_WITH_CNTNRS = 3 ) )
-----------------------------------------

);



 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_TITLE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_WITH_CNTNRS',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_WITH_CNTNRS);
 
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'to_d_h',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'st_year_fin',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FINANCE_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 else
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
END ;

 END IF;

 
END;

 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'to_d_h',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'st_year_fin',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FINANCE_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 else

 end if; 
EXCEPTION

 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
END ;
